metadataRaw.title: Quickly Fix Bad Posture (By Releasing This Tight Muscle)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly fix bad back posture.

A main cause of rounded upper back posture is due to a condition called upper crossed syndrome, which is a blend of weakness and tightness in the muscles in the neck, upper back, and chest. This includes the upper trapezius muscle.

This video will focus on specifically lengthening and strengthening these muscles where it's needed the most.

While each exercise is different, they are meant to work together. To get the best results, make sure to use them all!

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/4ez3t2D
